main.content: {{infobox armor | image = Dverger circlet.png | appearance = ArmorDverger.png | description = A portable perpetual lightsource for the dungeon explorer. | id = HelmetDverger | type = Head | source = [[Haldor]] | buy = 620 | weight = 1.0 | durability = 0 | materials 1 = N/A | armor = 2 | other effect = Perpetual lightsource }} '''Dverger circlet''' is an armor piece. It grants the player a never-ending light source when equipped in the form of a cone wherever the player is looking. The circlet provides 2 armor, and its light source negates any sneak bonus while equipped. The circlet cannot be worn concurrently with any other head armor. The circlet can be attached to surfaces with item stands to be used as a light source that does not need refueling. == Availability == It can be purchased from [[Haldor]] for {{Item Link|Coins|620}}. == Trivia == "Dvergr" is the Old Norse word for "dwarf". == Gallery == Dverger Circlet illuminating an area.webp|The Dverger Circlet illuminating an area File:ArmorDverger.png {{Armor}} [[Fr:Diadème_de_Dverger]] [[cs:Trpasličí kroužek]] [[ru:Венец Двергов]]
